newsitem.title: UK: Rank to sell movie distribution unit-paper.
newsitem.headline: Rank to sell movie distribution unit-paper.

text.p: Rank Group Plc plans to sell its movie distribution unit and is expected to raise between 100 million stg and 150 million from the sale, according to a report in the Sunday Times.
The paper said the unit had been identified as a "non-core" operation by chief executive Andrew Teare, who is refocusing the leisure company on its higher margin businesses.
A spokesman for Rank said the company had no comment on what it described as "speculation".

In a trading statement last month, Rank said it had sold peripheral businesses worth over 200 million stg in the second half of 1996. Teare said the company was making "good trading and strategic progress" in a year of transition.
